settings.label: Social share image
settings.info: Shown when pages are shared on social/Google (1200×630 recommended). Per-page it falls back to the product or article image.

settings.label: 4kGraphics render service URL
settings.info: Host of the 4kGraphics server (/v1/render, /v1/buildplan). Used for server-side 4K renders.

settings.label: MEJA-CRM API URL (live pricing)
settings.info: Host of the CRM pricing engine. The configurator fetches the authoritative signed price (/v1/price) and live option model (/v1/options) from here. Leave blank to use the local estimate.

settings.label: AR service URL (View in your room)
settings.info: Host of the 4kGraphics AR endpoint (POST /v1/ar → glb/usdz/poster). Set once it exists to enable the 'View in your room' AR button on the configurator. Leave blank to hide it.

settings.content: The 4kGraphics engine browser.js is uploaded to theme assets and embedded on the configurator template.

settings.label: Free shipping threshold
settings.info: Order subtotal (in your store currency, e.g. 150) that unlocks free shipping. Shown as a progress bar in the cart drawer. Set 0 to hide.
